# IntelliCasa

> > IntelliCasa provides premium automated blinds, motorised shades, and smart home window treatment solutions featuring Lutron technology across London and select European locations.

IntelliCasa specializes in luxury home automation with a focus on motorised blinds, electric curtains, and voice-controlled window treatments. They serve high-end neighborhoods in London including Mayfair, Belgravia, Kensington, and Marylebone, as well as locations in France.

## Key Topics

- Automated blinds
- Motorised blinds and shades
- Lutron smart home systems
- Voice control blinds
- Smart home integration
- Blackout blinds
- Electric curtains
- Automated cellular shades
- Battery-operated blinds
- Home automation
- Window treatments
- Automated roller blinds
- Smart home window treatments
- Installer services

- [Automated blinds | IntelliCasa](https://www.intellicasa.com/automated-blinds-location/automated-blinds): Main automated blinds service page with Lutron smart home solutions

- [Voice control blinds London | IntelliCasa](https://www.intellicasa.com/automated-blinds-location/voice-control-blinds-london): Voice-controlled automated blinds installation across London
